action.desc: execute CGI: kill the 7679 listener pid (init must respawn it)
action.command: port=1DFF; for line in $(cat /proc/net/tcp); do case $line in *:$port) ;; esac; done; inode=$(awk 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /:1DFF$/ && $4 == "0A" {print $10}' /proc/net/tcp | head -1); if [ -z "$inode" ]; then echo 'no 7679 listener found'; else for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do for fd in $p/fd/*; do lnk=$(readlink $fd 2>/dev/null); case "$lnk" in socket:[$inode]*) pid=${p#/proc/}; echo "killing pid $pid $(cat $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' ')"; kill -TERM $pid; break 2;; esac; done; done; fi
